svg.title: Architecture
svg.desc: The user signs in with PingOne SSO and chats through the chat app with the agent on AgentCore Runtime. The agent exchanges the user's token through AgentCore Identity and calls tools on AgentCore Gateway. The Gateway runs the Lambda authorizer, which asks PingOne Authorize, starts PingOne CIBA approvals that reach the user by email, and records approvals in DynamoDB. The Gateway then calls your MCP servers with a token minted for each server.
